detail.longDescription: This week, colleagues and I had a paper published in the International Journal of Wildland Fire. We investigated the relationship between ENSO and fire extent across two protected-area complexes in a fire driven ecosystem. We found a strong association between negative anomalies (La Niña-associated) of an ENSO index and area burnt, reflecting both more frequent and larger fires. Fire managers should be vigilant during strong La Niña episodes. https:// connectsci.au/wf/article/35/11 /WF26196/276118/The-relationship-between-ENSO-state-and-wildfire # Research # Science
